items.title: Kabila launches new coalition with M23
items.description: In tonight's edition, Joseph Kabila has been named leader of a new rebel coalition, vowing to topple the government. Also, Africa's largest ever IPO has been extended. And Formula ⁠1 ⁠will return to ⁠Africa in ​the early 2030s, once a new circuit is built in Rwanda.

Saudi Arabia's military struggle against Houthi attacks
items.description: Houthi attacks on airports and energy facilities are putting Saudi Arabia under pressure. Could a Saudi-led international military offensive succeed against the Iran-aligned Houthi militia in Yemen?

items.title: French navy intercepts oil tanker south of La Réunion suspected of being part of Russia's shadow fleet
items.description: Footage released by the French Armed Forces shows French Navy personnel intercepting a vessel 'suspected of sailing under a false flag' south of La Réunion, a French overseas department in the Indian Ocean.

items.title: Russia Pounds Ukraine In Overnight Missile And Drone Attacks
items.description: Russia launched overnight missile and drone attacks across Ukraine, striking Kyiv, Kharkiv, and other regions. At least four people were killed in Kharkiv. The attacks came amid a US-proposed energy cease-fire that Moscow has not confirmed.

items.title: How NATO plans to combat potential attacks on the alliance from Russia
items.description: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with former U.S. Assistant Secretary for European Affairs Dan Hamilton about NATO's detailed plans to counter any possible Russian attack on the alliance.

items.title: BBC's Orla Guerin travels with Yemen's southern national security forces through desert battlefield
items.description: Orla Guerin travelled through Yemen, with forces loyal to its internationally recognised government, to a remote desert battlefield where Houthi rebels were dislodged just days ago.

items.title: Russia Plans Rehab Centers for Ukraine War Amputees
items.description: Russian officials are reporting growing demand for prosthetic limbs and rehabilitation among soldiers returning from Ukraine.

items.title: Houthis, Saudis exchange strikes on airports as Mideast conflict intensifies
items.description: The Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen accuse Saudi Arabia of striking the rebel-held airport in Sanaa. This accusation comes amid escalating clashes between the Houthis and Saudi-backed forces.

items.description: US President Donald Trump announced an immediate energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine on Sunday, Oct. 11, saying that both parties agreed to halt attacks on energy infrastructure. items.title: ‘These attacks must cease immediately’: Guterres condemns deadly Houthi strike on Riyadh airport
items.description: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has condemned a Houthi missile attack on Riyadh’s main airport that Saudi authorities say killed 12 people and wounded more than 300.
